description: This Python source file defines an in-memory Server-Sent Events (SSE) manager class, 'SSEManager', which handles subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and broadcasting of events to clients via asyncio queues. It facilitates real-time event streaming in an asynchronous environment, likely for a web API built with FastAPI or similar frameworks.

classes.name: SSEManager
classes.description: Manages subscriber queues for server-sent events, allowing clients to subscribe, unsubscribe, and receive event data streams asynchronously.

methods.name: None unsubscribe(self, event_id: int, queue: asyncio.Queue[str])
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the specified event's subscriber list.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, event_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a JSON-formatted data message to all subscribers of the specified event.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[str,None] event_stream(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: Async generator yielding SSE-formatted messages for a subscriber tied to an event.
